taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空首架客機進場改裝貨機，預計 2027 年投運
taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空 11 月 25 日舉行線上法人說明會。中央社報導，長榮航表示首架由客機改裝的貨機已於 11 月中旬開始改裝，預計 2027 年投入營運。公司規劃第二架於 2027 年、第三架於 2028 年進場，分批擴充貨運機隊。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air begins first passenger-to-freighter conversion, targets 2027 entry into service
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air held an online investor briefing on November 25. According to Taiwan’s Central News Agency, the airline said its first passenger-to-freighter conversion began in mid-November and the aircraft is expected to enter service in 2027. A second aircraft is scheduled to enter conversion in 2027, followed by a third in 2028.

international_aviation.headline: 挪威Norse Atlantic航空財務告急：須取得融資才能維持營運
international_aviation.summary: 挪威長程低成本航空公司Norse Atlantic航空11月25日在奧斯陸證交所發布內線消息公告，表示公司財務狀況危急，必須取得融資才能應付短期流動資金需求並繼續營運。
